title: Life, Like Lice, Can Be Messy And Itchy

contact_edits.before: There is something schematic about the play. I'm not sure that it justifies its structure or even the metaphor that's emblazoned in its title: life equated with lice, messy with itchy. I don't know that it ends up making any particular statement about grief, loss or survival. But it does show them all happening -- believably, sometimes touchingly, and nearly always entertainingly. It's an impressive calling card. - Scratch runs through Nov. 2 at the Factory Theatre. Call 416-504-9971 for more information.
